note: Every source Nimai's content draws on, and the exact version used. 'kind': classical (primary text), research (academic), practitioner (experienced teacher's book), workbook (course material). 'verified' says where the edition details came from; nothing here is guessed. The books themselves are never stored in the repo, and all content drawn from them is paraphrased and cited, never quoted.
